# Elysium review context

Read `AGENTS.md` for architecture, commands and completion criteria, and `REVIEW.md` for severity, risk tiers and convergent re-reviews. Apply `.github/instructions/react.instructions.md` to web changes and `.github/instructions/backend.instructions.md` to backend changes.

Cite concrete changed lines and failure scenarios. Report a bug class once with all locations; at most five style nits. Re-review new changes, except for Important findings. Do not infer that instruction files activate reviewer apps or enforce branch protection.
